_help: Python 3.11+. Loaded at startup. Set GUARDRAILS_CONFIG to another complete JSON policy file. Paths accept ~ and environment variables. Example names are placeholders; replace them with your own.

reply.reminder: reply rule: The operator reads this reply. Answer in 1 to 5 lines, result first. No recap, no step narration, no list of what you checked. Detail goes in a file or a T3 rendered page (html_render) with one line pointing to it. A Stop hook rejects a final reply over {max_lines} lines or {max_chars} characters. Briefs and messages you write to agents are not covered: make those as detailed as they need.
reply.blocked: Your reply was {lines} lines and {chars} characters. The limit is {max_lines} lines and {max_chars} characters. Send the reply again in 1 to 5 lines: the result first, then only what the operator must decide or do. Put the detail in a file or, inside T3, a rendered page (html_preview, then html_render) and point to it in one line. Do not apologise or mention this check. If the operator asked for the long text itself in this turn, write it to a file and give the path.

guarding.credential_reason: Credentials never enter model context. Use the owning tool's authenticated interface.
guarding.commit_reason: Shared index: require git commit -- <paths> for ordinary commits under ~/agency/. Positional paths also work. Name only your paths; -a/--all is refused. During an active operation, pathless commits, git merge --continue and git cherry-pick --continue are allowed.
guarding.host_reason: Production server refused by resolved SSH configuration. Use an allowed CI host.
